what: deploy_vii.live.tools read_pages bound on a line source (B22 follow-up, PF-R7)
allowed_on_line_source: last-first+1 <= max_lines_per_line_read AND the measured bytes <= max_line_read_bytes, however few the lines (S14-A02); the line-count check comes before any iteration over the range
measure: sum of len(span.text.encode('utf-8')) over the located line:N spans first..last; a line the source does not hold counts 0
page_sources: unchanged: at most max_spans_per_read pages, refusal text unchanged
line_refusal: bad arguments: on a line source, at most 200 lines totalling 32768 bytes, per call
tool_description: Verbatim text of pages first_page..last_page of one source (at most 5 pages; on a line source, at most 200 lines totalling 32768 bytes), each page or line as a SOURCE block with its locator.
why: Model-testing pilot 2026-11-02: under B22 an HTML filing is a line source, so 5 spans are about 1.3 KB per call and 16 calls see about 80 lines of a 1.6 MB pack (MANAGER root-cause note).
amended_by: PF-R9 (controller gate finding PF1-G1: an unbounded last_page made both loops unbounded)
amended_by_cp1h_r10: CP1H-R10 (user via MANAGER, 2026-11-02: "Approve 32 KB"); was 8192 under PF-R7
amended_by_s14_a02: S14-A02 (review fix, 2026-11-07): a read of max_spans_per_read lines or fewer had no byte bound (five 1 MB lines returned 5 MB while six lines of 36 KB were refused); every line read is now measured. The largest five-line window in the retained text sources is 6,992 bytes, so no retained read changes.
